WITNES.SETH: WHEREAS,Lot 48 Owner is the owner infee of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 48 in Block 1429 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Lot 48 Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to and the Lot 48 Building being herein collectively called the "Lot 48 Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain parcels of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 3 and Lot 4 in Block 1429 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street address of 1297-1299 Third Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement being herein called the “Developer Building," and the Developer Land and the. Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"; the Lot 48 Premises or the Developer Premises, individually, the "Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct new improvements (said improvements also hereinafter being referred to as the *Developer Building") upon the Developer Land; WHEREAS, the Developer desires to construct the Developer Building with a bulk in excess of the bulk that would be permitted under the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (the “Zoning Resolution") if the lots comprising the Developer Land were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, Developer desires to utilize the procedure available pursuant to Section 12- 10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Lot 48 Premises, and the Developer Premises into a combined zoning lot (the“Combined Zoning Lot") for the purpose of making available the excess floor area development rights for utilization in connection with the construction of the Developer Building: 00361166.3.1
